account_access.definition: Apple ID, iCloud account login/lockout, password reset, sign-in verification. NOT iCloud storage (that is subscription).

billing_payment.definition: Charges, invoices, payment methods, billing errors, or unexpected payments.

device_issue.definition: Physical hardware only: battery drain, cracked/broken screen, device won't turn on, physical damage. NOT software crashes.

app_software_issue.definition: iOS/macOS/app bugs, updates, crashes, freezes, slow performance, software errors. Device names alone are NOT evidence of software intent.

subscription.definition: Apple Music, Apple TV+, iCloud storage subscription, renewal, cancellation of a recurring plan.

refund_return.definition: Refund, return, reimbursement, cancellation of a purchase, or money back request.

order_purchase.definition: Buying, ordering, delivery, shipping, product availability, or purchase status.

connectivity_issue.definition: Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, cellular, mobile data, network, or connection problem.

general_information.definition: General question, how-to request, product information, or policy information.

complaint.definition: Explicit complaint or strongly negative feedback without a clearer actionable issue.

insufficient_information.definition: Message that does not match another frozen intent with enough evidence (e.g. bare mentions, URLs only, very short messages).
